## One canvas. Everyone on it.

Send a link. They sign in and join the canvas.

Every conversation, artifact, and tool state can go live: state syncs to everyone on the link as it changes, and anyone on the call can turn on video, audio, or screen share to look at the same thing at the same time. No separate meeting link and nothing to install -- they open the link, sign in, and they are on the canvas.
